topic: Change of Basis in Linear Algebra

sections.title: The Concept of 'Perspective' (Prerequisite Review)
lecture_lines: A basis is just a set of coordinate axes.
Vectors exist independently of our chosen basis.
Coordinates depend entirely on that chosen basis.
animations: Display original perspective grid with origin (0,0) in #FFFFFF.
Highlight grid lines using #FFD700 for clarity.
Shift grid perspective using tilt effect, color #00CED1.
Animate vector rotation to emphasize changing viewpoint, #ADFF2F.

sections.title: Visualizing the Basis Transformation
lecture_lines: We compare a standard basis with a custom one.
Grid lines warp to represent the new basis.
Space is unchanged, only our ruler changes.
animations: Display standard basis vectors (i,j) as #FFFFFF arrows.

sections.title: The Change-of-Basis Matrix
lecture_lines: The transition matrix maps between different bases.
Construct columns from new basis vectors.
It acts as a translator for coordinates.
animations: Define matrix M with column vectors v1, v2.
Show matrix multiplication action on arbitrary vector x.

sections.title: The Formula and Application
lecture_lines: Inverse matrices reverse the coordinate conversion.
This powers systems like self-driving car navigation.
animations: Apply formula to sample vector, final result in #32CD32.
